name: b02 — two line heads, never one GST total split in half (§15.2)
workings: One device line, taxableBase 33333 at 500 bps. taxHead(33333, 500) = divHalfUp(16,666,500, 20,000) = floor((33,333,000 + 20,000) / 40,000) = floor(833.825) = 833 per head, so the invoice GST total is 833 + 833 = 1666. Computing one total first would give percentAmount(33333, 500) = divHalfUp(16,666,500, 10,000) = floor((33,333,000 + 10,000) / 20,000) = floor(1667.15) = 1667, split 834 / 833 (mutant M-B02) — a rupee's worth of GSTR-1 mismatch per thousand such lines. netPaise = 33333 + 833 + 833 = 34999; roundTotalToRupee(34999) = floor((69,998 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(350.49) x 100 = 35000, rounding +1.
